differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: EPO deficiency from CKD stage 1 in a diabetic hypertensive patient is the most common cause of his documented anemia.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Chronic NSAID use for low‑back pain and possible occult GI bleeding in an older adult can produce iron‑deficiency anemia.

differential.name: Vitamin B12 deficiency (metformin‑associated)
differential.rationale: Long‑term metformin therapy and dietary factors may lead to B12 deficiency contributing to macrocytic anemia.

differential.name: Hemolytic anemia (drug‑induced or mechanical)
differential.rationale: Elevated bilirubin (15 mg/dL) and high platelet indices raise suspicion for a hemolytic process, possibly from recent medications post‑MI.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Age > 60 with unexplained cytopenias and abnormal platelet parameters warrants consideration of an early MDS.
